tbesh_html:
1) to pray, entreat, supplicate
1a) (Qal) to pray, entreat
1b) (Niphal) to be supplicated, be entreated
1c) (Hiphil) to make supplication, plead

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to burn incense in worship, i.e. intercede (reciprocally, listen to prayer)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (rather denominative from H6281 (עֶתֶר));
